description: This PHP class 'Immigration' extends 'ListableDisplayField' and is part of the OrangeHRM project. It defines display fields related to immigration records within the HR system, providing methods to get the associated DTO class, entity aliases, and specific fields.

classes.name: Immigration
classes.description: A display field class for immigration records in the OrangeHRM reporting module.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the DTO associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias used in query building.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields this display field will query.
